ko.title: [소매업 개론 #1] 중간 상인을 없앨 수는 있어도, 중간 상인의 역할까지 없앨 수는 없다

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **한 줄 요약:** 유통이란 제품을 만든 사람에게서 사용하는 사람에게로 옮기는 데 필요한 모든 업무를 의미합니다. "중간 상인을 없앤다"는 것은 그 업무가 사라지는 것이 아니라, 단지 다른 누군가에게 그 업무가 넘어가는 것을 뜻합니다.

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **유통(Distribution)**(교과서에서는 *마케팅 경로* 또는 *유통 경로*라고 함)은 제품을 생산자로부터 최종 사용자에게 이동시키는 조직과 활동의 집합이며, 그 과정에서 발생하는 소유권 이전까지 포함합니다.

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: 이 과정에서 가장 중요한 세 가지 아이디어가 있습니다.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: 유통은 기업의 목록이 아니라 기능의 목록이다.**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: 당신에게 도달하는 모든 제품은 누군가가 다음의 각 업무를 수행했기 때문에 가능했습니다:

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
- sort and combine it with other products
- finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - 자금 조달 및 재고 보유 (판매되지 않을 경우 위험 부담)

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
- handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - 결제, 반품 및 사후 서비스 처리
이 중 선택 사항은 하나도 없습니다.

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: 채널 설계는 *누가 각 기능을 수행할지*를 결정하는 것이지, 기능 수행 여부를 결정하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: 이것이 이 분야 전체의 핵심 원칙입니다: **중개인은 제거할 수 있지만, 중개인의 기능은 제거할 수 없습니다.** 그 기능들은 제조업체로 상향 이동하거나, 고객에게 하향 이동하거나, UPS나 제3자 물류 업체와 같은 전문가에게 측면 이동할 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: 중개인이 존재하는 이유는 거래 횟수를 줄여주기 때문이다.**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: 5개의 농장이 5개의 식료품점에 판매하려고 한다고 가정해 봅시다.

segments.src: Selling direct means every farm negotiates, ships, and invoices with every store:
segments.tr: 직거래를 한다는 것은 모든 농장이 모든 매장과 협상하고, 배송하고, 송장을 처리해야 한다는 뜻입니다:

segments.src: Now put one wholesaler in the middle.
segments.tr: 이제 중간에 도매상 한 곳을 넣어봅시다.

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: 각 농장은 도매상과 거래하고, 각 매장도 도매상과 거래하게 됩니다:

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: 생산자가 500곳, 매장이 5,000곳이라면 그 격차는 엄청나게 커집니다.

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: 중개인은 통행료를 받는 것이 아니라, 전체 시스템을 더 저렴하게 만듦으로써 마진을 얻습니다.

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: 이와 관련된 업무로 **구색의 불일치(discrepancy of assortment)** 해결이라는 것이 있습니다.

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: 생산자는 *소수의 품목을 대량으로* 만듭니다. 예를 들어 유제품 공장은 수백만 갤런의 우유만 생산합니다.

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: 가정에서는 *다양한 품목을 소량으로* 원합니다. 우유 반 갤런, 빵 한 덩이, 세제 한 상자처럼 말이죠.

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: 중개인은 많은 생산자로부터 제품을 모으고, 대량 화물을 소비자 단위로 나누고, 한 선반에 다양한 구색을 갖춤으로써 그 격차를 해소합니다.
고전적인 네 가지 효용은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **형태 효용(Form utility)** — 원재료를 사용 가능한 제품으로 전환 (원유를 밀봉된 저온 살균 우유로 가공)

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
segments.tr: - **시간 효용(Time utility)** — 당신이 원할 *때* 이용 가능하게 함

segments.src: - **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
segments.tr: - **장소 효용(Place utility)** — 당신이 원하는 *곳*에 이용 가능하게 함

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **소유 효용(Possession utility)** — 소유권 이전을 쉽게 만듦 (결제, 신용, 할부 금융, 보관 등)

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: 소매업체는 주로 뒤의 세 가지 효용을 생산합니다.

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 편의점에서는 생수 한 병이 1달러 정도인데 공항 게이트에서는 4달러인 이유입니다. 물은 동일하지만, 시간과 장소가 다르기 때문입니다.

segments.src: on a Tuesday in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: 당신은 퇴근길에 식료품점에 들러 우유 반 갤런을 약 4달러에, 커피 한 봉지를 약 12달러에 삽니다.

segments.src: You stop at the grocery store on the way home and pick up a half gallon of milk for around $4 and a bag of coffee for about $12.
segments.tr: 이미 어떤 일들이 이루어져야 했는지 살펴보세요:

segments.src: Look at what had to already be true:
segments.tr: - 유제품 협동조합은 수십 개의 가족 농장에서 원유를 **집하(accumulation)**했습니다. 어떤 단일 농장도 가공업체의 탱크로리를 안정적으로 채울 수 없기 때문입니다.

segments.src: - A dairy cooperative **accumulated** raw milk from dozens of family farms, because no single farm could reliably fill a processor's tanker (accumulation).
segments.tr: - 가공업체는 이를 저온 살균하여 반 갤런 단위로 병에 담았습니다 (**형태 효용**).

segments.src: - A processor pasteurized and bottled it into half gallons (**form utility**).
segments.tr: - 40마일 떨어진 냉장 유통 센터는 **대량 화물을 분할(broke bulk)**했습니다. 팔레트가 상자가 되고, 상자가 당신의 매장에서 하루에 실제로 판매하는 12개의 우유통이 되었습니다.

segments.src: - A refrigerated distribution center 40 miles away **broke bulk** — a pallet became a case, a case became the twelve jugs your store actually sells in a day.
segments.tr: - 매장은 당신 집에서 3마일 거리에 있고 (**장소**), 오후 9시에도 문을 열었으며 (**시간**), 우유가 유통기한이 지나도록 팔리지 않을 경우 재고 위험을 감수합니다.

segments.src: - The store is three miles from your house (**place**) and open at 9 p.m. (**time**), and it holds the inventory risk if that milk hits its sell-by date unsold.
segments.tr: - 커피는 콜롬비아의 농장에서 수출업자, 수입업자, 로스터, 유통업자를 거쳐 이동했습니다. 선반에 놓이기 전 다섯 번의 손을 거친 셈입니다.

segments.src: - The coffee traveled from a farm in Colombia through an exporter, an importer, a roaster, and a distributor — five sets of hands before the shelf.
segments.tr: - 당신이 카드를 찍으면 그것은 당신의 것이 됩니다 (**소유**).

segments.src: - You tap a card and it's yours (**possession**).
segments.tr: 그리고 조용히 일어나는 일: 그 매장은 약 30,000개의 다른 품목을 취급합니다.

segments.src: And the quiet one: that store carries roughly 30,000 different items.
segments.tr: 이 매장이 없다면, 오늘 밤 당신의 쇼핑은 30,000개의 개별 생산자로부터 30,000번의 별도 구매를 해야 하는 일이 되었을 것입니다.

segments.src: Without it, tonight's trip would have been 30,000 separate purchases from 30,000 separate producers.
segments.tr: **D2C(소비자 직접 판매)의 반론.** 지난 10년간 매트리스, 면도기, 안경, 커피 구독 스타트업 같은 브랜드들은 고객에게 직접 판매하며 마진을 제거했다고 광고했습니다.

segments.src: **The direct-to-consumer counterpoint.** Over the past decade, brands like mattress, razor, eyewear, and coffee-subscription startups sold straight to customers and advertised it as removing the markup.

segments.tr: 하지만 그들이 무엇을 떠맡았는지 주목하세요: 창고 보관, 포장, FedEx와 USPS를 통해 구매한 라스트 마일 배송, 무료 반품, 고객 지원, 그리고 가장 비용이 많이 드는 것인 구글과 메타에 광고비를 지불하여 매장이 예전에는 무료로 창출하던 수요를 만들어내는 일입니다.

segments.src: But notice what they took on: warehousing, packing, last-mile shipping bought from FedEx and USPS, free returns, customer support, and — the expensive one — paying Google and Meta to generate the demand a storefront used to generate for free.
segments.tr: 많은 브랜드가 결국 제품을 다시 타겟(Target)이나 월마트(Walmart) 매장에 입점시켰습니다.

segments.src: Many of those brands eventually put their products *back* into Target and Walmart.
segments.tr: 이것이 1절에서 말한 원칙이 현실에서 드러나는 모습입니다. 기능은 결코 사라지지 않았습니다.

segments.src: That's the principle from section 1, playing out in public: the functions never disappeared.

segments.tr: 1. 유통은 상품과 소유권을 생산자에서 최종 사용자에게 이동시키는 기능의 묶음이며, 이러한 기능은 항상 누군가에 의해 수행되어야 합니다.

segments.src: 1. Distribution is the bundle of functions that moves goods and ownership from producer to end user — and those functions must be performed by someone, always.
segments.tr: 2. 중개인이 살아남는 이유는 시스템 내 거래 횟수를 줄이고 생산자가 만드는 것과 가정이 구매하는 것 사이의 불일치를 해결해주기 때문입니다.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries survive because they cut the number of transactions in the system and resolve the mismatch between what producers make and what households buy.
segments.tr: 3. 소매업은 시간, 장소, 소유 효용의 형태로 실질적인 경제적 가치를 창출하며, 이것이 바로 당신이 공항에서 비싼 값을 지불하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: 3. Retailing creates genuine economic value in the form of time, place, and possession utility — which is what you're actually paying for at the airport.

segments.tr: **Q1.** 마케팅(유통) 경로를 가장 잘 설명한 것은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: **Q1.** Which statement best describes a marketing (distribution) channel?

segments.tr: 기업이 쇼핑객에게 도달하기 위해 사용하는 광고 매체

segments.src: The advertising media a company uses to reach shoppers

segments.tr: 제품과 그 소유권을 생산자에서 최종 사용자에게 이동시키는 조직과 활동의 집합

segments.src: The set of organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user
The physical trucks and warehouses a manufacturer owns

segments.tr: (O/X)** 브랜드가 자체 웹사이트에서 소비자에게 직접 판매할 때, 보관, 배송, 반품 처리와 같은 유통 경로 기능은 제거됩니다.

segments.src: (O/X)** When a brand sells directly to consumers on its own website, the channel functions of storage, delivery, and returns handling are eliminated.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 식료품점이 밤 11시에도 우유를 살 수 있도록 자정까지 문을 여는 것은

segments.src: **Q3.** A grocery store staying open until midnight so you can buy milk at 11 p.m.

segments.tr: - **마케팅 경로(유통 경로)** — 제품과 그 소유권을 생산자에서 최종 사용자에게 이동시키는 상호 의존적인 조직과 활동의 집합.

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **중개인(Intermediary)** — 생산자와 최종 사용자 사이에 위치하여 하나 이상의 경로 기능을 수행하는 모든 당사자(도매상, 유통업자, 소매상, 대리인, 브로커).

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **접촉 효율성(Contactual efficiency)** — 중개인이 추가될 때 시장 내 총 거래 횟수가 감소하는 것; 중개인 존재의 주된 경제적 정당성.

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **대량 화물 분할(Breaking bulk)** — 생산자 규모의 대량 화물을 매장과 가정이 실제로 구매하는 소량으로 나누는 것.

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **소유 효용(Possession utility)** — 결제, 신용, 금융 또는 유연한 지불 조건을 통해 소유권 이전을 쉽게 만듦으로써 창출되는 가치.

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.

segments.tr: *정답: **Q1 — B.** 유통 경로는 매체, 트럭, 가격이 아니라 상품 **및 소유권**의 흐름에 의해 정의됩니다.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (거짓).** 기능은 여전히 발생합니다. 이제 브랜드가 직접 수행하거나(또는 운송업체나 3PL로부터 구매), 배송을 기다리고 반품을 우편으로 보내는 등 고객이 일부를 부담하게 됩니다.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** The functions still happen; the brand now performs them itself (or buys them from carriers and 3PLs) and the customer absorbs some too, by waiting for shipping and mailing returns back.
segments.tr: 직거래는 누가 업무를 수행하고 비용이 얼마인지 변화시킬 뿐, 업무 자체를 제거하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Selling direct changes who does the work and what it costs — it never removes it.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B.** 영업시간 연장은 당신이 원할 *때* 제품을 이용할 수 있게 하므로 시간 효용입니다.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Extended hours make the product available *when* you want it, which is time utility.
segments.tr: 위치는 장소 효용이 될 것이며, "접촉 효율성"은 효용이 아니라 중개인이 필요한 이유에 대한 거래 횟수 논리입니다.*

segments.src: Location would be place utility; "contactual efficiency" isn't a utility at all, it's the transaction-count argument for intermediaries.*
segments.tr: 입지는 장소 효용(place utility)이 될 것이며, "계약 효율성(contactual efficiency)"은 효용이 전혀 아니며, 이는 중개인을 위한 거래 횟수 논거입니다.*

zh.title: [零售 101 #1] 你可以剔除中间商——但无法剔除中间商的工作

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **一句话总结：** 分销是将产品从生产者转移到使用者所需的所有工作——而“剔除中间商”并不会消除这些工作，只是将其转嫁给了其他人。

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **分销**（在教科书中称为*营销渠道*或*分销渠道*）是指将产品从生产者转移到最终用户的一系列组织和活动，以及在此过程中发生的所有权转移。

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: 本课程主要围绕三个核心观点展开。

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: 分销是一系列职能的集合，而非一系列公司的集合。**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: 每一个到达你手中的产品，都有人完成了以下每一项工作：

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
segments.tr: - 将大宗货物拆分为小批量

segments.src: - sort and combine it with other products
segments.tr: - 分类并与其他产品组合

segments.src: - finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - 提供资金并持有库存（如果卖不出去，还要承担风险）

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
segments.tr: - 推广产品并解答相关问题

segments.src: - handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - 处理付款、退货和售后服务
这些工作没有一项是可选的。

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: 渠道设计决定的是*由谁来执行每一项职能*——而不是决定是否执行这些职能。

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: 这是整个领域的核心原则：**你可以消除中间商，但你无法消除中间商的职能。** 它们会向上游转移给制造商，向下游转移给客户，或者横向转移给像 UPS 或第三方物流公司这样的专业机构。

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: 中间商的存在是因为他们减少了交易次数。**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: 假设有 5 个农场想要向 5 家杂货店销售产品。

segments.src: Selling direct means every farm negotiates, ships, and invoices with every store:
segments.tr: 直接销售意味着每个农场都要与每家商店进行谈判、发货和开票：

segments.src: Now put one wholesaler in the middle.
segments.tr: 现在在中间加入一个批发商。

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: 每个农场只需与批发商打交道；每家商店也只需与批发商打交道：
这被称为**接触效率**（contactual efficiency）。

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: 如果有 500 个生产者和 5,000 家商店，这种差距将变得巨大。

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: 中间商赚取利润是因为他们使整个系统成本更低，而不是因为他们是收费站。

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: 还有一个相关的工作叫做解决**分类差异**（discrepancy of assortment）。

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: 生产者生产*少量品种的大量产品*——一家乳制品厂生产数百万加仑牛奶，除此之外什么都不生产。

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: 家庭需要*多种产品的少量需求*——半加仑牛奶、一条面包、一盒洗涤剂。

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: 中间商通过从许多生产者那里积累产品、将大宗货物拆分为消费者规模的单位，并在货架上组合成各种商品，从而弥合了这一差距。
分销创造了真正的价值，称为*效用*（utility）。**

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **形式效用** — 将原材料转化为可用的产品（将生牛奶变成密封、巴氏杀菌的半加仑装）

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
segments.tr: - **时间效用** — 在你想要的时候提供产品

segments.src: - **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
segments.tr: - **地点效用** — 在你想要的地方提供产品

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **占有效用** — 使所有权转移变得容易（结账、信贷、融资、预付定金）

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: 零售商主要创造后三种效用。

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么一瓶水在街角商店卖大约一美元，而在机场登机口卖四美元的原因——水本身是一样的；但时间和地点不同。

segments.src: on a Tuesday in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: 在俄亥俄州哥伦布市的一个周二。

segments.src: You stop at the grocery store on the way home and pick up a half gallon of milk for around $4 and a bag of coffee for about $12.
segments.tr: 你在回家的路上顺便去杂货店，买了半加仑牛奶（约 4 美元）和一袋咖啡（约 12 美元）。

segments.src: Look at what had to already be true:
segments.tr: 看看这背后必须已经成立的事实：

segments.src: - A dairy cooperative **accumulated** raw milk from dozens of family farms, because no single farm could reliably fill a processor's tanker (accumulation).
segments.tr: - 一个乳制品合作社**积累**了来自几十个家庭农场的生牛奶，因为没有单一农场能可靠地装满加工商的油罐车（积累）。

segments.src: - A processor pasteurized and bottled it into half gallons (**form utility**).
segments.tr: - 加工商对其进行巴氏杀菌并装入半加仑瓶中（**形式效用**）。

segments.src: - A refrigerated distribution center 40 miles away **broke bulk** — a pallet became a case, a case became the twelve jugs your store actually sells in a day.
segments.tr: - 40 英里外的一个冷藏配送中心**拆分了大宗货物**——一个托盘变成了一箱，一箱变成了你商店一天实际销售的十二瓶。

segments.src: - The store is three miles from your house (**place**) and open at 9 p.m. (**time**), and it holds the inventory risk if that milk hits its sell-by date unsold.
segments.tr: - 商店离你家只有三英里（**地点**），晚上 9 点还在营业（**时间**），如果牛奶在保质期前没卖掉，它还要承担库存风险。

segments.src: - The coffee traveled from a farm in Colombia through an exporter, an importer, a roaster, and a distributor — five sets of hands before the shelf.
segments.tr: - 咖啡从哥伦比亚的农场经过出口商、进口商、烘焙商和分销商——在到达货架前经过了五双手。

segments.src: - You tap a card and it's yours (**possession**).
segments.tr: - 你刷卡，它就属于你了（**占有**）。

segments.src: And the quiet one: that store carries roughly 30,000 different items.
segments.tr: 还有一个容易被忽视的事实：那家商店大约有 30,000 种不同的商品。

segments.src: Without it, tonight's trip would have been 30,000 separate purchases from 30,000 separate producers.
segments.tr: 如果没有它，今晚的购物之旅将变成从 30,000 个不同的生产者那里进行 30,000 次单独的购买。

segments.src: **The direct-to-consumer counterpoint.** Over the past decade, brands like mattress, razor, eyewear, and coffee-subscription startups sold straight to customers and advertised it as removing the markup.
segments.tr: **直接面向消费者（DTC）的反面观点。** 在过去十年中，像床垫、剃须刀、眼镜和咖啡订阅初创公司等品牌直接向客户销售，并将其宣传为去除了加价。

segments.src: But notice what they took on: warehousing, packing, last-mile shipping bought from FedEx and USPS, free returns, customer support, and — the expensive one — paying Google and Meta to generate the demand a storefront used to generate for free.
segments.tr: 但请注意他们承担了什么：仓储、包装、从 FedEx 和 USPS 购买的最后一英里运输、免费退货、客户支持，以及——昂贵的一项——向 Google 和 Meta 付费以产生以前由店面免费产生的需求。

segments.src: Many of those brands eventually put their products *back* into Target and Walmart.
segments.tr: 许多这些品牌最终还是把产品放回了 Target 和 Walmart。

segments.src: That's the principle from section 1, playing out in public: the functions never disappeared.
segments.tr: 这就是第 1 节中的原则在现实中的体现：职能从未消失。

segments.src: 1. Distribution is the bundle of functions that moves goods and ownership from producer to end user — and those functions must be performed by someone, always.
segments.tr: 1. 分销是将商品和所有权从生产者转移到最终用户的一系列职能集合——这些职能必须始终由某人来执行。

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries survive because they cut the number of transactions in the system and resolve the mismatch between what producers make and what households buy.
segments.tr: 2. 中间商之所以存在，是因为他们减少了系统中的交易次数，并解决了生产者生产的产品与家庭购买的产品之间的不匹配问题。

segments.src: 3. Retailing creates genuine economic value in the form of time, place, and possession utility — which is what you're actually paying for at the airport.
segments.tr: 3. 零售以时间、地点和占有效用的形式创造了真正的经济价值——这正是你在机场实际支付费用的原因。

segments.src: **Q1.** Which statement best describes a marketing (distribution) channel?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 哪种说法最能描述营销（分销）渠道？

segments.src: The advertising media a company uses to reach shoppers
segments.tr: 公司用来接触购物者的广告媒体

segments.src: The set of organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user
segments.tr: 将产品及其所有权从生产者转移到最终用户的一系列组织和活动

segments.src: The physical trucks and warehouses a manufacturer owns
segments.tr: 制造商拥有的实体卡车和仓库

segments.src: (O/X)** When a brand sells directly to consumers on its own website, the channel functions of storage, delivery, and returns handling are eliminated.
segments.tr: (O/X)** 当品牌在自己的网站上直接向消费者销售时，仓储、配送和退货处理的渠道职能就被消除了。

segments.src: **Q3.** A grocery store staying open until midnight so you can buy milk at 11 p.m.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 一家杂货店营业到午夜，让你可以在晚上 11 点买到牛奶。
这主要创造了哪种效用？

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **营销渠道（分销渠道）** — 将产品及其所有权从生产者转移到最终用户的一系列相互依赖的组织和活动。

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **中间商** — 位于生产者和最终用户之间的任何一方（批发商、分销商、零售商、代理商、经纪人），执行一项或多项渠道职能。

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **接触效率** — 加入中间商后市场中交易总数的减少；这是他们存在的主要经济理由。

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **拆分大宗货物** — 将生产者规模的大批量货物拆分为商店和家庭实际购买的小批量货物。

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.
segments.tr: - **占有效用** — 通过结账、信贷、融资或灵活的付款条款，使所有权转移变得容易而创造的价值。

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.
segments.tr: *答案：**Q1 — B。** 渠道的定义在于商品**和所有权**的流动，而不是媒体、卡车或价格。

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** The functions still happen; the brand now performs them itself (or buys them from carriers and 3PLs) and the customer absorbs some too, by waiting for shipping and mailing returns back.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X（错误）。** 这些职能仍然存在；品牌现在自己执行它们（或从承运商和第三方物流公司购买服务），客户也承担了一部分，例如等待运输和寄回退货。

segments.src: Selling direct changes who does the work and what it costs — it never removes it.
segments.tr: 直接销售改变了谁来做这项工作以及成本是多少——它从未消除这项工作。

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Extended hours make the product available *when* you want it, which is time utility.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B。** 延长营业时间使产品在*你想要的时候*可用，这就是时间效用。

segments.src: Location would be place utility; "contactual efficiency" isn't a utility at all, it's the transaction-count argument for intermediaries.*
segments.tr: 地点会是地点效用；“接触效率”根本不是一种效用，它是中间商存在的交易数量论点。*

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **वितरण** (पाठ्यपुस्तकों में, *मार्केटिंग चैनल* या *डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन चैनल*) संगठनों और गतिविधियों का वह समूह है जो किसी उत्पाद को उत्पादक से अंतिम उपयोगकर्ता तक पहुँचाता है, साथ ही रास्ते में होने वाले स्वामित्व के हस्तांतरण को भी संभालता है।

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**

segments.tr: यह पूरे क्षेत्र का मूल सिद्धांत है: **आप मध्यस्थ को समाप्त कर सकते हैं, लेकिन आप मध्यस्थ के कार्यों को समाप्त नहीं कर सकते।** वे निर्माता की ओर अपस्ट्रीम, ग्राहक की ओर डाउनस्ट्रीम, या यूपीएस (UPS) या तीसरे पक्ष की लॉजिस्टिक फर्म जैसे विशेषज्ञ की ओर स्थानांतरित हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **मार्केटिंग चैनल (डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन चैनल)** — परस्पर निर्भर संगठनों और गतिविधियों का समूह जो किसी उत्पाद और उसके स्वामित्व को उत्पादक से अंतिम उपयोगकर्ता तक ले जाता है।

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **मध्यस्थ** — उत्पादक और अंतिम उपयोगकर्ता के बीच स्थित कोई भी पक्ष (थोक व्यापारी, वितरक, खुदरा विक्रेता, एजेंट, दलाल) जो एक या अधिक चैनल कार्य करता है।

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **संपर्क दक्षता** — मध्यस्थों को जोड़ने पर बाजार में लेन-देन की कुल संख्या में कमी; उनके अस्तित्व का मुख्य आर्थिक औचित्य।

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **ब्रेकिंग बल्क** — बड़े उत्पादक-आकार के शिपमेंट को छोटी मात्रा में विभाजित करना जो स्टोर और परिवार वास्तव में खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.
segments.tr: - **स्वामित्व उपयोगिता** — चेकआउट, क्रेडिट, फाइनेंसिंग या लचीली भुगतान शर्तों के माध्यम से स्वामित्व को स्थानांतरित करना आसान बनाकर बनाया गया मूल्य।

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.

es.title: [Retailing 101 #1] Puedes eliminar al intermediario, pero no su trabajo

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **En una línea:** La distribución es todo el trabajo necesario para trasladar un producto desde quien lo fabrica hasta quien lo usa; y "eliminar al intermediario" no borra ese trabajo, simplemente se lo entrega a otra persona.

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **La distribución** (en los libros de texto, el *canal de marketing* o *canal de distribución*) es el conjunto de organizaciones y actividades que trasladan un producto desde el productor hasta el usuario final, junto con la transferencia de propiedad que ocurre en el camino.

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: Tres ideas tienen la mayor parte del peso en este curso.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: La distribución es una lista de funciones, no una lista de empresas.**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: Cada producto que te llega requirió que alguien hiciera cada uno de estos trabajos:

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
- sort and combine it with other products
segments.tr: - clasificarlo y combinarlo con otros productos

segments.src: - finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - financiarlo y mantener inventario (y asumir el riesgo si no se vende)

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
segments.tr: - promoverlo y responder preguntas al respecto

segments.src: - handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - gestionar pagos, devoluciones y servicio postventa

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: El diseño de un canal decide *quién realiza cada función*, nunca si se realiza o no.

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: Ese es el principio fundamental de todo el campo: **puedes eliminar al intermediario, pero no puedes eliminar las funciones del intermediario.** Se desplazan río arriba hacia el fabricante, río abajo hacia el cliente, o hacia un lado a un especialista como UPS o una empresa de logística de terceros.

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: Los intermediarios existen porque reducen el número de transacciones.**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: Supongamos que 5 granjas quieren vender a 5 tiendas de comestibles.

segments.tr: Vender directamente significa que cada granja negocia, envía y factura con cada tienda:

segments.tr: Ahora pongamos a un mayorista en el medio.

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: Cada granja trata con el mayorista; cada tienda trata con el mayorista:

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: Con 500 productores y 5,000 tiendas, la brecha se vuelve enorme.

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: El intermediario gana su margen haciendo que todo el sistema sea más económico, no por ser un peaje.

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: Hay un trabajo relacionado llamado resolver la **discrepancia de surtido**.

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: Los productores hacen una *gran cantidad de pocas cosas*: una lechería produce millones de galones de leche y nada más.

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: Los hogares quieren una *pequeña cantidad de muchas cosas*: medio galón de leche, una barra de pan, una caja de detergente.

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: Los intermediarios cierran esa brecha acumulando de muchos productores, fraccionando en unidades del tamaño del consumidor y reuniendo un surtido en un solo estante.
La distribución crea valor real, llamado *utilidad*.**

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **Utilidad de forma**: convertir materias primas en un producto utilizable (leche cruda en un medio galón sellado y pasteurizado)

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
segments.tr: - **Utilidad de tiempo**: tenerlo disponible *cuando* lo deseas

segments.src: - **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
segments.tr: - **Utilidad de lugar**: tenerlo disponible *donde* lo deseas

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **Utilidad de posesión**: facilitar la transferencia de propiedad (pago, crédito, financiamiento, apartado)

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: Los minoristas producen principalmente las últimas tres.

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.
segments.tr: Es por eso que una botella de agua cuesta alrededor de un dólar en una tienda de la esquina y cuatro dólares en la puerta de embarque de un aeropuerto; el agua es idéntica, el tiempo y el lugar no.

segments.src: on a Tuesday in Columbus, Ohio.
You stop at the grocery store on the way home and pick up a half gallon of milk for around $4 and a bag of coffee for about $12.
segments.tr: Te detienes en la tienda de comestibles de camino a casa y compras medio galón de leche por unos $4 y una bolsa de café por unos $12.

segments.src: Look at what had to already be true:
segments.tr: Mira lo que ya tuvo que ser verdad:

segments.src: - A dairy cooperative **accumulated** raw milk from dozens of family farms, because no single farm could reliably fill a processor's tanker (accumulation).
segments.tr: - Una cooperativa lechera **acumuló** leche cruda de decenas de granjas familiares, porque ninguna granja por sí sola podía llenar de forma fiable el camión cisterna de un procesador (acumulación).

segments.src: - A processor pasteurized and bottled it into half gallons (**form utility**).
segments.tr: - Un procesador la pasteurizó y embotelló en medios galones (**utilidad de forma**).

segments.src: - A refrigerated distribution center 40 miles away **broke bulk** — a pallet became a case, a case became the twelve jugs your store actually sells in a day.
segments.tr: - Un centro de distribución refrigerado a 40 millas de distancia **fraccionó** los envíos: un palé se convirtió en una caja, una caja se convirtió en los doce envases que tu tienda realmente vende en un día.

segments.src: - The store is three miles from your house (**place**) and open at 9 p.m. (**time**), and it holds the inventory risk if that milk hits its sell-by date unsold.
segments.tr: - La tienda está a tres millas de tu casa (**lugar**) y abierta a las 9 p.m. (**tiempo**), y asume el riesgo de inventario si esa leche llega a su fecha de caducidad sin venderse.

segments.src: - The coffee traveled from a farm in Colombia through an exporter, an importer, a roaster, and a distributor — five sets of hands before the shelf.
segments.tr: - El café viajó desde una granja en Colombia a través de un exportador, un importador, un tostador y un distribuidor: cinco pares de manos antes de llegar al estante.

segments.src: - You tap a card and it's yours (**possession**).
segments.tr: - Pasas una tarjeta y es tuyo (**posesión**).

segments.src: And the quiet one: that store carries roughly 30,000 different items.
segments.tr: Y el dato silencioso: esa tienda tiene aproximadamente 30,000 artículos diferentes.

segments.src: Without it, tonight's trip would have been 30,000 separate purchases from 30,000 separate producers.
segments.tr: Sin ella, el viaje de esta noche habría sido de 30,000 compras separadas a 30,000 productores separados.

segments.src: **The direct-to-consumer counterpoint.** Over the past decade, brands like mattress, razor, eyewear, and coffee-subscription startups sold straight to customers and advertised it as removing the markup.
segments.tr: **El contrapunto directo al consumidor.** Durante la última década, marcas de colchones, maquinillas de afeitar, gafas y startups de suscripción de café vendieron directamente a los clientes y lo publicitaron como la eliminación del margen de ganancia.

segments.src: But notice what they took on: warehousing, packing, last-mile shipping bought from FedEx and USPS, free returns, customer support, and — the expensive one — paying Google and Meta to generate the demand a storefront used to generate for free.
segments.tr: Pero observa de qué se hicieron cargo: almacenamiento, empaque, envío de última milla comprado a FedEx y USPS, devoluciones gratuitas, atención al cliente y —el costoso— pagarle a Google y Meta para generar la demanda que una tienda física solía generar gratis.

segments.src: Many of those brands eventually put their products *back* into Target and Walmart.
segments.tr: Muchas de esas marcas eventualmente volvieron a poner sus productos en Target y Walmart.

segments.src: That's the principle from section 1, playing out in public: the functions never disappeared.
segments.tr: Ese es el principio de la sección 1, manifestándose en público: las funciones nunca desaparecieron.

segments.src: 1. Distribution is the bundle of functions that moves goods and ownership from producer to end user — and those functions must be performed by someone, always.
segments.tr: 1. La distribución es el conjunto de funciones que traslada los bienes y la propiedad del productor al usuario final, y esas funciones deben ser realizadas por alguien, siempre.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries survive because they cut the number of transactions in the system and resolve the mismatch between what producers make and what households buy.
segments.tr: 2. Los intermediarios sobreviven porque reducen el número de transacciones en el sistema y resuelven el desajuste entre lo que los productores fabrican y lo que los hogares compran.

segments.src: 3. Retailing creates genuine economic value in the form of time, place, and possession utility — which is what you're actually paying for at the airport.
segments.tr: 3. El comercio minorista crea un valor económico genuino en forma de utilidad de tiempo, lugar y posesión, que es por lo que realmente estás pagando en el aeropuerto.

segments.src: **Q1.** Which statement best describes a marketing (distribution) channel?
segments.tr: **Q1.** ¿Qué afirmación describe mejor un canal de marketing (distribución)?

segments.src: The advertising media a company uses to reach shoppers
segments.tr: Los medios publicitarios que una empresa utiliza para llegar a los compradores

segments.src: The set of organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user
segments.tr: El conjunto de organizaciones y actividades que trasladan un producto y su propiedad del productor al usuario final

segments.src: The physical trucks and warehouses a manufacturer owns
segments.tr: Los camiones y almacenes físicos que posee un fabricante
La estrategia de precios del minorista

segments.src: (O/X)** When a brand sells directly to consumers on its own website, the channel functions of storage, delivery, and returns handling are eliminated.
segments.tr: (O/X)** Cuando una marca vende directamente a los consumidores en su propio sitio web, se eliminan las funciones de canal de almacenamiento, entrega y gestión de devoluciones.

segments.src: **Q3.** A grocery store staying open until midnight so you can buy milk at 11 p.m.
segments.tr: **Q3.** Una tienda de comestibles que permanece abierta hasta la medianoche para que puedas comprar leche a las 11 p.m.

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **Canal de marketing (canal de distribución)**: el conjunto de organizaciones y actividades interdependientes que trasladan un producto y su propiedad del productor al usuario final.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **Intermediario**: cualquier parte posicionada entre el productor y el usuario final (mayorista, distribuidor, minorista, agente, corredor) que realiza una o más funciones de canal.

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **Eficiencia contactual**: la reducción en el número total de transacciones en un mercado cuando se agregan intermediarios; la principal justificación económica de su existencia.

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **Fraccionamiento (breaking bulk)**: la división de grandes envíos del tamaño del productor en las cantidades más pequeñas que las tiendas y los hogares realmente compran.

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.
segments.tr: - **Utilidad de posesión**: el valor creado al facilitar la transferencia de propiedad mediante pago, crédito, financiamiento o condiciones de pago flexibles.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: **Q1 — B.** Un canal se define por el flujo de bienes **y propiedad**, no por medios, camiones o precios.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** The functions still happen; the brand now performs them itself (or buys them from carriers and 3PLs) and the customer absorbs some too, by waiting for shipping and mailing returns back.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (Falso).** Las funciones siguen ocurriendo; la marca ahora las realiza por sí misma (o las compra a transportistas y 3PLs) y el cliente también absorbe algunas al esperar el envío y enviar las devoluciones por correo.

segments.src: Selling direct changes who does the work and what it costs — it never removes it.
segments.tr: Vender directamente cambia quién hace el trabajo y cuánto cuesta, nunca lo elimina.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Extended hours make the product available *when* you want it, which is time utility.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B.** Un horario extendido hace que el producto esté disponible *cuando* lo deseas, lo cual es utilidad de tiempo.

segments.src: Location would be place utility; "contactual efficiency" isn't a utility at all, it's the transaction-count argument for intermediaries.*
segments.tr: La ubicación sería utilidad de lugar; la "eficiencia contactual" no es una utilidad en absoluto, es el argumento del recuento de transacciones para los intermediarios.*

ar.title: [تجزئة 101 #1] يمكنك الاستغناء عن الوسيط — ولكن ليس عن عمل الوسيط

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **في سطر واحد:** التوزيع هو كل العمل المطلوب لنقل منتج من صانعه إلى مستخدمه — و"الاستغناء عن الوسيط" لا يلغي هذا العمل، بل ينقله إلى شخص آخر.

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **التوزيع** (في الكتب الدراسية، يُسمى *قناة التسويق* أو *قناة التوزيع*) هو مجموعة المنظمات والأنشطة التي تنقل المنتج من المنتج إلى المستخدم النهائي، إلى جانب نقل الملكية الذي يحدث في الطريق.

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: ثلاث أفكار تحمل معظم الثقل في هذه الدورة.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: التوزيع هو قائمة بالوظائف، وليس قائمة بالشركات.**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: كل منتج يصل إليك قام شخص ما بكل هذه المهام من أجله:

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
segments.tr: - تقسيم الشحنات الكبيرة إلى شحنات صغيرة

segments.src: - sort and combine it with other products
- finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - تمويله والاحتفاظ بالمخزون (وتحمل المخاطر إذا لم يُبع)

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
segments.tr: - الترويج له والإجابة على الأسئلة المتعلقة به

segments.src: - handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - التعامل مع الدفع، والمرتجعات، وخدمة ما بعد البيع

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: تصميم القناة يقرر *من يؤدي كل وظيفة* — وليس ما إذا كانت ستُؤدى أم لا.

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: هذا هو المبدأ الأساسي للمجال بأكمله: **يمكنك القضاء على الوسيط، لكن لا يمكنك القضاء على وظائف الوسيط.** فهي تنتقل إلى الأعلى نحو المصنع، أو إلى الأسفل نحو العميل، أو جانبياً إلى متخصص مثل UPS أو شركة لوجستيات خارجية.

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: يوجد الوسطاء لأنهم يقللون من عدد المعاملات.**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: لنفترض أن 5 مزارع تريد البيع لـ 5 متاجر بقالة.

segments.src: Now put one wholesaler in the middle.
segments.tr: الآن ضع تاجر جملة واحداً في المنتصف.

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: كل مزرعة تتعامل مع تاجر الجملة؛ وكل متجر يتعامل مع تاجر الجملة:

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: مع 500 منتج و5000 متجر، تصبح الفجوة هائلة.

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: يكسب الوسيط هامشه بجعل النظام بأكمله أرخص، وليس بكونه كشك تحصيل رسوم.

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: هناك وظيفة ذات صلة تسمى حل **تناقض التشكيلة**.

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: ينتج المنتجون *كمية كبيرة من أشياء قليلة* — مصنع ألبان ينتج ملايين الجالونات من الحليب ولا شيء غير ذلك.

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: تريد الأسر *كمية صغيرة من أشياء كثيرة* — نصف جالون من الحليب، رغيف خبز واحد، علبة منظف واحدة.

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: يسد الوسطاء هذه الفجوة بالتجميع من العديد من المنتجين، وتقسيم الكميات الكبيرة إلى وحدات بحجم المستهلك، وتجميع تشكيلة على رف واحد.

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **منفعة الشكل** — تحويل المدخلات الخام إلى منتج قابل للاستخدام (حليب خام إلى نصف جالون مبستر ومغلق)

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
- **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
- **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **منفعة الحيازة** — تسهيل نقل الملكية (الدفع، الائتمان، التمويل، الشراء بالتقسيط)

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: ينتج تجار التجزئة في الغالب الثلاثة الأخيرة.

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.

fr.title: [Retailing 101 #1] Vous pouvez éliminer l'intermédiaire — mais pas le travail de l'intermédiaire

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **En une phrase:** La distribution est tout le travail nécessaire pour transférer un produit de celui qui l'a fabriqué à celui qui l'utilise — et « éliminer l'intermédiaire » ne supprime pas ce travail, cela le confie simplement à quelqu'un d'autre.

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **La Distribution** (dans les manuels, le *canal de marketing* ou *canal de distribution*) est l'ensemble des organisations et des activités qui déplacent un produit du producteur à l'utilisateur final, ainsi que le transfert de propriété qui se produit en chemin.

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: Trois idées constituent l'essentiel de ce cours.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: La distribution est une liste de fonctions, pas une liste de sociétés.**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: Chaque produit qui vous parvient a dû être traité selon chacune de ces étapes:

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
segments.tr: - diviser les gros envois en petits envois

segments.src: - sort and combine it with other products
segments.tr: - le trier et le combiner avec d'autres produits

segments.src: - finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - le financer et le stocker (et absorber le risque s'il ne se vend pas)

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
segments.tr: - le promouvoir et répondre aux questions à son sujet

segments.src: - handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - gérer le paiement, les retours et le service après-vente
Aucune de ces tâches n'est facultative.

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: Un design de canal décide *qui exerce chaque fonction* — jamais s'il faut l'exercer ou non.

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: C'est le principe fondamental de tout ce domaine: **vous pouvez éliminer l'intermédiaire, mais vous ne pouvez pas éliminer les fonctions de l'intermédiaire.** Elles se déplacent en amont vers le fabricant, en aval vers le client, ou latéralement vers un spécialiste comme UPS ou une entreprise de logistique tierce.

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: Les intermédiaires existent parce qu'ils réduisent le nombre de transactions.**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: Supposons que 5 exploitations agricoles veuillent vendre à 5 épiceries.

segments.src: Selling direct means every farm negotiates, ships, and invoices with every store:
segments.tr: La vente directe signifie que chaque exploitation négocie, expédie et facture avec chaque magasin:

segments.src: Now put one wholesaler in the middle.
segments.tr: Maintenant, placez un grossiste au milieu.

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: Chaque exploitation traite avec le grossiste; chaque magasin traite avec le grossiste:

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: Avec 500 producteurs et 5 000 magasins, l'écart devient énorme.

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: L'intermédiaire gagne sa marge en rendant tout le système moins cher, pas en étant un péage.

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: Il y a un travail connexe appelé résoudre la **disparité d'assortiment**.

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: Les producteurs font une *grande quantité de peu de choses* — une laiterie produit des millions de gallons de lait et rien d'autre.

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: Les ménages veulent une *petite quantité de nombreuses choses* — un demi-gallon de lait, un pain, une boîte de détergent.

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: Les intermédiaires comblent cet écart en accumulant les produits de nombreux producteurs, en divisant les gros lots en unités de taille consommateur, et en assemblant un assortiment sur une seule étagère.
La distribution crée une véritable valeur, appelée *utilité*.**

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **Utilité de forme** — transformer les matières premières en un produit utilisable (le lait cru en un demi-gallon scellé et pasteurisé)

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
segments.tr: - **Utilité de temps** — l'avoir disponible *quand* vous le souhaitez

segments.src: - **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
segments.tr: - **Utilité de lieu** — l'avoir disponible *où* vous le souhaitez

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **Utilité de possession** — faciliter le transfert de propriété (caisse, crédit, financement, réserve)

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: Les détaillants produisent principalement les trois derniers.

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi une bouteille d'eau coûte environ 1 dollar dans un magasin du coin et 4 dollars à la porte d'un aéroport — l'eau est identique; le moment et le lieu ne le sont pas.

segments.src: on a Tuesday in Columbus, Ohio.
You stop at the grocery store on the way home and pick up a half gallon of milk for around $4 and a bag of coffee for about $12.
segments.tr: Vous vous arrêtez à l'épicerie en rentrant chez vous et prenez un demi-gallon de lait pour environ 4 $ et un paquet de café pour environ 12 $.

segments.src: Look at what had to already be true:
segments.tr: Regardez ce qui devait déjà être vrai:

segments.src: - A dairy cooperative **accumulated** raw milk from dozens of family farms, because no single farm could reliably fill a processor's tanker (accumulation).
segments.tr: - Une coopérative laitière a **accumulé** du lait cru provenant de dizaines d'exploitations familiales, car aucune exploitation individuelle ne pouvait remplir de manière fiable le réservoir d'un transformateur (accumulation).

segments.src: - A processor pasteurized and bottled it into half gallons (**form utility**).
segments.tr: - Un transformateur l'a pasteurisé et mis en bouteille en demi-gallons (**utilité de forme**).

segments.src: - A refrigerated distribution center 40 miles away **broke bulk** — a pallet became a case, a case became the twelve jugs your store actually sells in a day.
segments.tr: - Un centre de distribution réfrigéré à 40 miles a **divisé le lot** — une palette est devenue une caisse, une caisse est devenue les douze cruches que votre magasin vend réellement en une journée.

segments.src: - The store is three miles from your house (**place**) and open at 9 p.m. (**time**), and it holds the inventory risk if that milk hits its sell-by date unsold.
segments.tr: - Le magasin est à trois miles de votre maison (**lieu**) et ouvert à 21h (**temps**), et il porte le risque d'inventaire si ce lait atteint sa date limite de vente sans être vendu.

segments.src: - The coffee traveled from a farm in Colombia through an exporter, an importer, a roaster, and a distributor — five sets of hands before the shelf.
segments.tr: - Le café a voyagé d'une ferme en Colombie à travers un exportateur, un importateur, un torréfacteur et un distributeur — cinq étapes avant l'étagère.

segments.src: - You tap a card and it's yours (**possession**).
segments.tr: - Vous appuyez sur une carte et c'est à vous (**possession**).

segments.src: And the quiet one: that store carries roughly 30,000 different items.
segments.tr: Et la question silencieuse: ce magasin porte environ 30 000 articles différents.

segments.src: Without it, tonight's trip would have been 30,000 separate purchases from 30,000 separate producers.
segments.tr: Sans lui, le voyage de ce soir aurait été 30 000 achats séparés auprès de 30 000 producteurs séparés.

segments.src: **The direct-to-consumer counterpoint.** Over the past decade, brands like mattress, razor, eyewear, and coffee-subscription startups sold straight to customers and advertised it as removing the markup.
segments.tr: **Le contre-argument de la vente directe au consommateur.** Au cours de la dernière décennie, des marques comme les matelas, rasoirs, verres correcteurs et abonnements de café ont vendu directement aux clients et l'ont annoncé comme supprimant la marge.
Certains ont véritablement réduit les prix.

segments.src: But notice what they took on: warehousing, packing, last-mile shipping bought from FedEx and USPS, free returns, customer support, and — the expensive one — paying Google and Meta to generate the demand a storefront used to generate for free.
segments.tr: Mais remarquez ce qu'ils ont pris en charge: l'entreposage, l'emballage, la livraison du dernier kilomètre achetée auprès de FedEx et USPS, les retours gratuits, l'assistance clientèle, et — le coûteux — payer Google et Meta pour générer la demande qu'une vitrine générait autrefois gratuitement.

segments.src: Many of those brands eventually put their products *back* into Target and Walmart.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de ces marques ont finalement remis leurs produits *de retour* dans Target et Walmart.

segments.src: That's the principle from section 1, playing out in public: the functions never disappeared.
segments.tr: C'est le principe de la section 1, qui se joue en public: les fonctions n'ont jamais disparu.

segments.src: 1. Distribution is the bundle of functions that moves goods and ownership from producer to end user — and those functions must be performed by someone, always.
segments.tr: 1. La distribution est l'ensemble des fonctions qui déplacent les biens et la propriété du producteur à l'utilisateur final — et ces fonctions doivent être exercées par quelqu'un, toujours.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries survive because they cut the number of transactions in the system and resolve the mismatch between what producers make and what households buy.
segments.tr: 2. Les intermédiaires survivent parce qu'ils réduisent le nombre de transactions dans le système et résolvent le décalage entre ce que les producteurs font et ce que les ménages achètent.

segments.src: 3. Retailing creates genuine economic value in the form of time, place, and possession utility — which is what you're actually paying for at the airport.
segments.tr: 3. La vente au détail crée une véritable valeur économique sous la forme d'utilité de temps, de lieu et de possession — c'est ce que vous payez réellement à l'aéroport.

segments.tr: **Q1.** Laquelle des déclarations suivantes décrit le mieux un canal de marketing (distribution)?

segments.tr: Les médias publicitaires qu'une entreprise utilise pour atteindre les acheteurs

segments.tr: **Q3.** Un magasin d'épicerie qui reste ouvert jusqu'à minuit pour que vous puissiez acheter du lait à 23h.

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **Canal de marketing (canal de distribution)** — l'ensemble des organisations et des activités interdépendantes qui déplacent un produit et sa propriété du producteur à l'utilisateur final.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **Intermédiaire** — toute partie positionnée entre le producteur et l'utilisateur final (grossiste, distributeur, détaillant, agent, courtier) qui exerce une ou plusieurs fonctions de canal.

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **Efficacité transactionnelle** — la réduction du nombre total de transactions sur un marché lorsque des intermédiaires sont ajoutés; la principale justification économique de leur existence.

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **Division de lot** — diviser les gros envois de taille producteur en petites quantités que les magasins et ménages achètent réellement.

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.
segments.tr: - **Utilité de possession** — la valeur créée en facilitant le transfert de propriété, par caisse, crédit, financement ou modalités de paiement flexibles.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.
segments.tr: *Réponses: **Q1 — B.** Un canal est défini par le flux de biens **et de propriété**, pas par les médias, les camions ou le prix.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** The functions still happen; the brand now performs them itself (or buys them from carriers and 3PLs) and the customer absorbs some too, by waiting for shipping and mailing returns back.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (Faux).** Les fonctions se produisent toujours; la marque les exerce maintenant elle-même (ou les achète auprès de transporteurs et de 3PL) et le client en absorbe aussi, en attendant l'expédition et en renvoyant les retours par courrier.

segments.src: Selling direct changes who does the work and what it costs — it never removes it.
segments.tr: La vente directe change qui fait le travail et ce qu'il coûte — cela ne l'élimine jamais.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Extended hours make the product available *when* you want it, which is time utility.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B.** Les heures prolongées rendent le produit disponible *quand* vous le souhaitez, ce qui est une utilité de temps.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.

in.title: [Retailing 101 #1] Anda Dapat Menghilangkan Perantara — Tetapi Bukan Pekerjaan Perantara

segments.src: > **In one line:** Distribution is all the work required to move a product from whoever made it to whoever uses it — and "cutting out the middleman" doesn't delete that work, it just hands it to someone else.
segments.tr: > **Dalam satu baris:** Distribusi adalah semua pekerjaan yang diperlukan untuk memindahkan produk dari siapa pun yang membuatnya ke siapa pun yang menggunakannya — dan "menghilangkan perantara" tidak menghapus pekerjaan itu, hanya menyerahkannya kepada orang lain.

segments.src: **Distribution** (in textbooks, the *marketing channel* or *distribution channel*) is the set of organizations and activities that move a product from the producer to the end user, along with the transfer of ownership that happens on the way.
segments.tr: **Distribusi** (dalam buku teks, *saluran pemasaran* atau *saluran distribusi*) adalah kumpulan organisasi dan aktivitas yang memindahkan produk dari produsen ke pengguna akhir, bersama dengan transfer kepemilikan yang terjadi di sepanjang jalan.

segments.src: Three ideas carry most of the weight in this course.
segments.tr: Tiga ide membawa sebagian besar beban dalam kursus ini.

segments.src: Distribution is a list of functions, not a list of companies.**
segments.tr: Distribusi adalah daftar fungsi, bukan daftar perusahaan.**

segments.src: Every product that reaches you had someone do each of these jobs:
segments.tr: Setiap produk yang sampai kepada Anda memiliki seseorang yang melakukan masing-masing pekerjaan ini:

segments.src: - break large shipments into small ones
segments.tr: - memecah pengiriman besar menjadi pengiriman kecil

segments.src: - sort and combine it with other products
segments.tr: - mengurutkan dan menggabungkannya dengan produk lain

segments.src: - finance it and hold inventory (and eat the risk if it doesn't sell)
segments.tr: - membiayainya dan menyimpan inventaris (dan menanggung risiko jika tidak terjual)

segments.src: - promote it and answer questions about it
- handle payment, returns, and after-sale service
segments.tr: - menangani pembayaran, pengembalian, dan layanan purna jual
Tidak ada satupun dari ini yang bersifat opsional.

segments.src: A channel design decides *who performs each function* — never whether it gets performed.
segments.tr: Desain saluran memutuskan *siapa yang melakukan setiap fungsi* — tidak pernah apakah fungsi itu dilakukan.

segments.src: That's the core principle of the whole field: **you can eliminate the intermediary, but you cannot eliminate the intermediary's functions.** They shift upstream to the manufacturer, downstream to the customer, or sideways to a specialist like UPS or a third-party logistics firm.
segments.tr: Itu adalah prinsip inti dari seluruh bidang: **Anda dapat menghilangkan perantara, tetapi Anda tidak dapat menghilangkan fungsi perantara.** Mereka bergeser ke hulu ke produsen, ke hilir ke pelanggan, atau ke samping ke spesialis seperti UPS atau perusahaan logistik pihak ketiga.

segments.src: Intermediaries exist because they cut the number of transactions.**
segments.tr: Perantara ada karena mereka mengurangi jumlah transaksi.**

segments.src: Suppose 5 farms want to sell to 5 grocery stores.
segments.tr: Misalkan 5 pertanian ingin menjual ke 5 toko kelontong.

segments.src: Selling direct means every farm negotiates, ships, and invoices with every store:
segments.tr: Penjualan langsung berarti setiap pertanian bernegosiasi, mengirim, dan mengirim faktur ke setiap toko:

segments.src: Now put one wholesaler in the middle.
segments.tr: Sekarang masukkan satu grosir di tengahnya.

segments.src: Each farm deals with the wholesaler; each store deals with the wholesaler:
segments.tr: Setiap pertanian berurusan dengan grosir; setiap toko berurusan dengan grosir:

segments.src: With 500 producers and 5,000 stores the gap becomes enormous.
segments.tr: Dengan 500 produsen dan 5.000 toko, kesenjangan menjadi sangat besar.

segments.src: The intermediary earns its margin by making the whole system cheaper, not by being a toll booth.
segments.tr: Perantara mendapatkan marginnya dengan membuat seluruh sistem lebih murah, bukan dengan menjadi gerbang tol.

segments.src: There's a related job called resolving the **discrepancy of assortment**.
segments.tr: Ada pekerjaan terkait yang disebut menyelesaikan **ketidaksesuaian asortimen**.

segments.src: Producers make a *large quantity of a few things* — a dairy makes millions of gallons of milk and nothing else.
segments.tr: Produsen membuat *jumlah besar dari beberapa hal* — susu membuat jutaan galon susu dan tidak ada yang lain.

segments.src: Households want a *small quantity of many things* — a half gallon of milk, one loaf of bread, one box of detergent.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga menginginkan *jumlah kecil dari banyak hal* — setengah galon susu, satu roti, satu kotak deterjen.

segments.src: Intermediaries close that gap by accumulating from many producers, breaking bulk into consumer-sized units, and assembling an assortment on one shelf.
segments.tr: Perantara menutup kesenjangan itu dengan mengumpulkan dari banyak produsen, memecah jumlah besar menjadi unit berukuran konsumen, dan merakit asortimen di satu rak.
Distribusi menciptakan nilai nyata, yang disebut *utilitas*.**

segments.src: - **Form utility** — turning raw inputs into a usable product (raw milk into a sealed, pasteurized half gallon)
segments.tr: - **Utilitas bentuk** — mengubah input mentah menjadi produk yang dapat digunakan (susu mentah menjadi setengah galon yang tersegel dan dipasteurisasi)

segments.src: - **Time utility** — having it available *when* you want it
- **Place utility** — having it available *where* you want it
segments.tr: - **Utilitas tempat** — memilikinya tersedia *di mana* Anda menginginkannya

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — making ownership easy to transfer (checkout, credit, financing, layaway)
segments.tr: - **Utilitas kepemilikan** — membuat kepemilikan mudah untuk ditransfer (checkout, kredit, pembiayaan, cicilan)

segments.src: Retailers mostly produce the last three.
segments.tr: Pengecer sebagian besar menghasilkan tiga yang terakhir.

segments.src: That's why a bottle of water costs about a dollar at a corner store and four dollars at an airport gate — the water is identical; the time and place are not.
segments.tr: Itu sebabnya sebotol air berharga sekitar satu dolar di toko sudut dan empat dolar di gerbang bandara — airnya identik; waktu dan tempatnya tidak.

segments.src: on a Tuesday in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: pada hari Selasa di Columbus, Ohio.

segments.src: You stop at the grocery store on the way home and pick up a half gallon of milk for around $4 and a bag of coffee for about $12.
segments.tr: Anda berhenti di toko kelontong di jalan pulang dan mengambil setengah galon susu sekitar $4 dan tas kopi sekitar $12.

segments.src: Look at what had to already be true:
segments.tr: Lihat apa yang harus sudah benar:

segments.src: - A dairy cooperative **accumulated** raw milk from dozens of family farms, because no single farm could reliably fill a processor's tanker (accumulation).
segments.tr: - Koperasi susu **mengumpulkan** susu mentah dari puluhan pertanian keluarga, karena tidak ada satu pertanian pun yang dapat dengan andal mengisi tangki pemroses (akumulasi).

segments.src: - A processor pasteurized and bottled it into half gallons (**form utility**).
segments.tr: - Sebuah pemroses mempasteurisasi dan membotolnya menjadi setengah galon (**utilitas bentuk**).

segments.src: - A refrigerated distribution center 40 miles away **broke bulk** — a pallet became a case, a case became the twelve jugs your store actually sells in a day.
segments.tr: - Pusat distribusi berpendingin 40 mil jauhnya **memecah jumlah besar** — palet menjadi kasus, kasus menjadi dua belas jug yang benar-benar dijual toko Anda dalam sehari.

segments.src: - The store is three miles from your house (**place**) and open at 9 p.m. (**time**), and it holds the inventory risk if that milk hits its sell-by date unsold.
segments.tr: - Toko ini tiga mil dari rumah Anda (**tempat**) dan buka pukul 9 malam (**waktu**), dan itu menahan risiko inventaris jika susu itu mencapai tanggal kadaluarsa tanpa terjual.

segments.src: - The coffee traveled from a farm in Colombia through an exporter, an importer, a roaster, and a distributor — five sets of hands before the shelf.
segments.tr: - Kopi perjalanan dari pertanian di Kolombia melalui eksportir, importir, pembakaran, dan distributor — lima set tangan sebelum rak.

segments.src: - You tap a card and it's yours (**possession**).
segments.tr: - Anda mengetuk kartu dan itu milik Anda (**kepemilikan**).

segments.src: And the quiet one: that store carries roughly 30,000 different items.
segments.tr: Dan yang tenang: toko itu membawa sekitar 30.000 item yang berbeda.

segments.src: Without it, tonight's trip would have been 30,000 separate purchases from 30,000 separate producers.
segments.tr: Tanpa itu, perjalanan malam ini akan menjadi 30.000 pembelian terpisah dari 30.000 produsen terpisah.

segments.src: **The direct-to-consumer counterpoint.** Over the past decade, brands like mattress, razor, eyewear, and coffee-subscription startups sold straight to customers and advertised it as removing the markup.
segments.tr: **Tandingan langsung-ke-konsumen.** Selama dekade terakhir, merek seperti kasur, pisau cukur, kacamata, dan startup berlangganan kopi dijual langsung kepada pelanggan dan diiklankan sebagai penghapusan markup.

segments.src: But notice what they took on: warehousing, packing, last-mile shipping bought from FedEx and USPS, free returns, customer support, and — the expensive one — paying Google and Meta to generate the demand a storefront used to generate for free.
segments.tr: Tetapi perhatikan apa yang mereka ambil: penyimpanan gudang, pengemasan, pengiriman mil terakhir yang dibeli dari FedEx dan USPS, pengembalian gratis, dukungan pelanggan, dan — yang mahal — membayar Google dan Meta untuk menghasilkan permintaan yang digunakan toko untuk menghasilkan secara gratis.

segments.src: Many of those brands eventually put their products *back* into Target and Walmart.
segments.tr: Banyak merek itu akhirnya memasukkan produk mereka *kembali* ke Target dan Walmart.

segments.src: That's the principle from section 1, playing out in public: the functions never disappeared.
segments.tr: Itu adalah prinsip dari bagian 1, bermain di publik: fungsi tidak pernah hilang.

segments.src: 1. Distribution is the bundle of functions that moves goods and ownership from producer to end user — and those functions must be performed by someone, always.
segments.tr: 1. Distribusi adalah bundel fungsi yang memindahkan barang dan kepemilikan dari produsen ke pengguna akhir — dan fungsi-fungsi itu harus dilakukan oleh seseorang, selalu.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries survive because they cut the number of transactions in the system and resolve the mismatch between what producers make and what households buy.
segments.tr: 2. Perantara bertahan karena mereka mengurangi jumlah transaksi dalam sistem dan menyelesaikan ketidaksesuaian antara apa yang dibuat produsen dan apa yang dibeli rumah tangga.

segments.src: 3. Retailing creates genuine economic value in the form of time, place, and possession utility — which is what you're actually paying for at the airport.
segments.tr: 3. Ritel menciptakan nilai ekonomi sejati dalam bentuk utilitas waktu, tempat, dan kepemilikan — itulah yang sebenarnya Anda bayar di bandara.

segments.tr: **Q1.** Pernyataan mana yang paling menggambarkan saluran pemasaran (distribusi)?

segments.src: - **Marketing channel (distribution channel)** — the set of interdependent organizations and activities that move a product and its ownership from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **Saluran pemasaran (saluran distribusi)** — kumpulan organisasi dan aktivitas yang saling bergantung yang memindahkan produk dan kepemilikannya dari produsen ke pengguna akhir.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — any party positioned between producer and end user (wholesaler, distributor, retailer, agent, broker) that performs one or more channel functions.
segments.tr: - **Perantara** — setiap pihak yang berada di antara produsen dan pengguna akhir (grosir, distributor, pengecer, agen, broker) yang melakukan satu atau lebih fungsi saluran.

segments.src: - **Contactual efficiency** — the reduction in the total number of transactions in a market when intermediaries are added; the main economic justification for their existence.
segments.tr: - **Efisiensi kontraktual** — pengurangan dalam jumlah total transaksi di pasar ketika perantara ditambahkan; pembenaran ekonomi utama untuk keberadaan mereka.

segments.src: - **Breaking bulk** — splitting large producer-sized shipments into the smaller quantities that stores and households actually buy.
segments.tr: - **Memecah jumlah besar** — membagi pengiriman berukuran besar produsen menjadi jumlah yang lebih kecil yang benar-benar dibeli toko dan rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Possession utility** — the value created by making ownership easy to transfer, through checkout, credit, financing, or flexible payment terms.
segments.tr: - **Utilitas kepemilikan** — nilai yang diciptakan dengan membuat kepemilikan mudah untuk ditransfer, melalui checkout, kredit, pembiayaan, atau syarat pembayaran yang fleksibel.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** A channel is defined by the flow of goods **and ownership**, not by media, trucks, or price.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — B.** Saluran didefinisikan oleh aliran barang **dan kepemilikan**, bukan oleh media, truk, atau harga.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** The functions still happen; the brand now performs them itself (or buys them from carriers and 3PLs) and the customer absorbs some too, by waiting for shipping and mailing returns back.

segments.src: Selling direct changes who does the work and what it costs — it never removes it.
segments.tr: Penjualan langsung mengubah siapa yang melakukan pekerjaan dan apa yang dikatakannya — tidak pernah menghapusnya.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Extended hours make the product available *when* you want it, which is time utility.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B.** Jam diperpanjang membuat produk tersedia *kapan* Anda menginginkannya, yang merupakan utilitas waktu.

segments.src: Location would be place utility; "contactual efficiency" isn't a utility at all, it's the transaction-count argument for intermediaries.*
